briefTitle: Predicting Response to Immunotherapy From Analysis of Live Tumor Biopsies (ELEPHAS-05)

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥18 years at time of consent.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Age ≥18 years at time of consent.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Able and willing to provide informed consent for participation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to provide informed consent is a subjective criterion, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a suspected or confirmed cancer diagnosis that is to be evaluated by means of a biopsy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or requirement to undergo a biopsy is a procedure-based judgment, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects who are newly diagnosed or have suspected cancer must be treatment-naïve at the time of biopsy. All other subjects should have the biopsy performed before starting their next line of treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior treatment timing relative to biopsy is complex and not a simple typed prior therapy check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a known auto-immune disease or prior condition (prior organ transplant, chronic kidney or liver disease) that renders them ineligible for immunotherapy (IO) treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease and prior conditions rendering a patient ineligible are investigator judgment calls, not clean typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Severely immunocompromised person(s). Examples include patients on immunosuppressants, HIV positive patients on antiretrovirals, post transplantation patients.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Immunocompromised status and related medications are not structured typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pregnant person(s).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy status is not represented among the allowed typed checks.
